segments.text:
V. 7.
And ſhall not God—The moſt juſt Judge, vindicate his own elect—Preſerve the Chriſtians from all their Adverſaries, and in particular ſave them out of the general Deſtruction, and avenge them of the Jews? Tho' he bear long with them—Tho' He does not immediately put an End, either to the Wrongs of the Wicked, or the Sufferings of good Men.
